seoTitle: How to Insert a Bookmark in Google Docs (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Add bookmarks in Google Docs to mark navigation points, link other text to them, and get a shareable URL that jumps straight to that section.
intro: Bookmarks let you drop an anchor point anywhere in a document, even outside of headings, so readers or collaborators can jump straight there. This guide covers placing a bookmark, linking text to it, and generating a shareable link that opens the document at that exact location, which is especially useful for interactive tables of contents.

steps.heading: Position your cursor
steps.body: Click exactly where you want to place a new navigation anchor point within your document.

steps.heading: Insert the bookmark
steps.body: Go to Insert, then Bookmark, to deploy a structural anchor token at your cursor's location.

steps.heading: Spot the bookmark icon
steps.body: Look for the small blue ribbon icon that appears in the margin, confirming the bookmark was successfully placed.

steps.heading: Copy the bookmark's link
steps.body: Click the bookmark icon to generate a shareable cloud URL tied directly to that specific location in your file.

steps.heading: Link other text to your bookmark
steps.body: Highlight companion text elsewhere and use Control+K or Command+K to link it directly to your new bookmark.

steps.heading: Manage and delete bookmarks
steps.body: Remove outdated bookmarks safely from the margin icon without disrupting your surrounding layout text.

faq.question: How is a bookmark different from linking to a heading?
faq.answer: A bookmark can be placed anywhere in the text, even mid-paragraph, while heading links only work at points where you've applied a heading style.

faq.question: Can I share a link that opens directly to a bookmark?
faq.answer: Yes, clicking the bookmark icon generates a shareable URL that opens the document scrolled to that exact location.

faq.question: Will deleting a bookmark break links pointing to it?
faq.answer: Yes, any text or links referencing a deleted bookmark will need to be updated or reassigned to a new anchor.

faq.question: Can I use bookmarks to build an interactive table of contents?
faq.answer: Yes, combining bookmarks with linked text is a common way to build custom navigation menus inside long documents.
